description: Recompute neighbour enrichment with corrected anchors and plot
code:
import json, re, pandas as pd, numpy as np, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from scipy.stats import fisher_exact
from statsmodels.stats.multitest import multipletests
nb=json.load(open("nb.json"))
rows=[]
for acc,v in nb.items():
    F=v["feats"]; c=(v["start"]+v["stop"])/2
    idx=None
    for i,f in enumerate(F):
        if f["s"]<=c<=f["e"]: idx=i; break
    if idx is None: idx=int(np.argmin([abs((f["s"]+f["e"])/2-c) for f in F]))
    ori=1 if v["strand"]=="+" else -1
    for i,f in enumerate(F):
        if i==idx: continue
        rows.append({"genome":acc,"org":v["org"],"d":(i-idx)*ori,
                     "product":re.sub(r"\s*\(?EC [\d\.\-]+\)?","",f["product"].strip()),
                     "same_strand":f["strand"]==v["strand"]})
N=pd.DataFrame(rows); ng=N.genome.nunique()
print("genomes:",ng,"neighbour CDS:",len(N))
prox=N[N.d.abs()<=2]; dist=N[(N.d.abs()>=4)&(N.d.abs()<=10)]
pc=prox.groupby("product").genome.nunique(); dc=dist.groupby("product").genome.nunique()
res=[]
for p,k in pc.items():
    if k<4 or p in ("hypothetical protein",""): continue
    kd=int(dc.get(p,0)); odds,pv=fisher_exact([[k,ng-k],[kd,ng-kd]],alternative="greater")
    res.append({"product":p,"within_2":int(k),"frac":round(k/ng,3),"at_4_to_10":kd,
                "odds":round(float(odds),2) if np.isfinite(odds) else np.inf,"p":pv})
R=pd.DataFrame(res).sort_values("within_2",ascending=False)
R["q"]=multipletests(R["p"],method="fdr_bh")[1]
pd.set_option("display.width",250); pd.set_option("display.max_colwidth",60)
print("\n=== CORRECTED recurrent neighbours (+/-2 genes), n=63 genomes ===")
print(R.to_string(index=False))
R.to_csv("neighbour_enrichment_corrected.csv",index=False)

# immediate-neighbour operon-level view: same strand, d = +1 only (downstream)
imm=N[(N.d==1)&(N.same_strand)]
print("\n=== Same-strand immediate DOWNSTREAM gene (d=+1), counts across 63 genomes ===")
print(imm.groupby("product").genome.nunique().sort_values(ascending=False).head(12).to_string())

Rp=R.sort_values("within_2")
fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(10,4.6))
y=np.arange(len(Rp))
ax.barh(y-0.19,Rp.within_2,height=.38,color="#4C78A8",label="within ±2 genes of the DUF1631 gene")
ax.barh(y+0.19,Rp.at_4_to_10,height=.38,color="#BBBBBB",label="4-10 genes away (internal control)")
ax.set_yticks(y); ax.set_yticklabels([p if len(p)<50 else p[:47]+"..." for p in Rp["product"]],fontsize=8)
for i,(k,q) in enumerate(zip(Rp.within_2,Rp["q"])): ax.text(k+0.3,i-0.19,f"q={q:.3f}",va="center",fontsize=7)
ax.set_xlabel("genomes (of 63)")
ax.set_title("Recurrent neighbours of DUF1631 genes, 63 beta/gammaproteobacterial species\n(corrected anchors; Fisher vs same-window distal control, BH-FDR)",fontsize=9.5)
ax.legend(fontsize=8,loc="lower right"); plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
